answer: In an agent economy managing a grove, every identity must lock 100 tokens before bidding for work, with withdrawals delayed 30 days. Creating 1,000 fake agents therefore ties up 100,000 tokens for at least a month; the delta in locked capital grows with every alias. This does not prove identities are unique, but it makes each additional bidder costly, preventing free account creation from making the market a haven for unlimited fake bidders.
